Reflection: the run has converged on a single coherent signal family, and gen 8 identified which components add value independently. Best joint evidence: cash-preferred yield + goodwill-netted knowledge intensity + gross profitability (fmb 7.67, alpha 5.6%, t=4.57, Sharpe 0.520); best portfolio reliability: goodwill-netted knowledge intensity dual-scaled (alpha 5.8%, t=5.03, Sharpe 0.498); best Sharpe: including advertising in the intangible stock (0.515). All at 0.141 coverage. Since these three refinements were each validated against the same base and improve *different* metrics, the final generation assembles them into the maximal specification, isolates the value-leg and quality-leg measurement choices so the winner is interpretable rather than merely fitted, and gives the conjunctive aggregator one more test with the strongest legs.

---SIGNAL 1---
NAME: Final_CashNetKnowledgeDual_Profitability
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(oancf, ib), COALESCE(xrd, SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), MA(revt, 3)), RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), at))), RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at))
HYPOTHESIS: The complete mechanism is cash-based cheapness, internally built intangible capital measured robustly against both revenue and assets, and demonstrated gross profitability; each element removes a distinct misclassification (accrual noise, overpaid acquirers, unprofitable shells), so the joint signal should be the strongest available expression of the value-times-intangibles interaction.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: This assembles the three refinements that each beat the full-universe base on a different metric — cash-preferred yield (fmb 7.67 in combination), dual scaling (alpha t=5.03), and gross profitability (alpha 5.9%) — all at unchanged 0.141 coverage. If it dominates on both FMB slope and alpha t-stat it is the natural final recommendation.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 2---
NAME: Final_TotalIntangibleCapital_Profitability
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(oancf, ib), COALESCE(xrd, SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), RATIO(SUB(ADD(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(TS_SUM(xad, 5), SUB(at, at))), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), MA(revt, 3))), RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at))
HYPOTHESIS: Brand capital built through advertising is expensed exactly as R&D is, so the economically complete hidden-asset stock is cumulative R&D plus advertising net of goodwill; adding brand capital should extend the mispricing to consumer-facing firms and improve risk-adjusted performance.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Including advertising in the intangible stock produced the archive's highest Sharpe (0.515) in its simpler form, indicating the added firms are genuinely mispriced rather than noise. Pairing that broader stock with the cash yield and profitability screen tests whether the best-Sharpe and best-slope refinements are complementary.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 3---
NAME: Final_AccrualYield_NetKnowledgeDual_Profitability
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(ib, COALESCE(xrd, SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), MA(revt, 3)), RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), at))), RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at))
HYPOTHESIS: If the abnormal return comes from intangible intensity and profitability rather than from the choice between cash and accrual cheapness, the earnings-based version of the maximal signal should perform comparably, making the simpler and more widely available value leg preferable.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Cash-based and earnings-based value legs have traded places across generations (cash better on Sharpe and FMB slope, earnings better on raw alpha), and this pair with Signal 1 cleanly isolates that one design choice at identical coverage. Establishing which leg the final signal needs matters for interpretation and implementability, not just for fit.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 4---
NAME: SymmetricIntangibleSpend_Yield_Intensity
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(ib, ADD(COALESCE(xrd, SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(xad, SUB(at, at)))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(ADD(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(TS_SUM(xad, 5), SUB(at, at))), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), MA(revt, 3)), RATIO(SUB(ADD(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(TS_SUM(xad, 5), SUB(at, at))), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), at)))
HYPOTHESIS: Accounting conservatism applies identically to R&D and advertising, so both should be added back to earnings *and* capitalized in the intangible stock; treating total intangible spending symmetrically in both legs is the internally consistent statement of the conservatism-correction story.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Every prior signal adds back only R&D to earnings while sometimes capitalizing advertising, an inconsistency that mismeasures cheapness precisely for brand-intensive firms. This is the one remaining substantive measurement question about the mechanism's economic content, and it is testable at full coverage thanks to the zero-spend convention.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite

---SIGNAL 5---
NAME: Conjunctive_CheapQuality_AND_NetKnowledge
EXPRESSION: MIN(RANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(oancf, ib), COALESCE(xrd, SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), RATIO(SUB(revt, cogs), at))), RANK(RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), MA(revt, 3))))
HYPOTHESIS: A true interaction portfolio requires firms to be jointly cheap-and-profitable *and* intangible-intensive; scoring each firm by its weaker of the two ranks enforces that conjunction and should produce a purer interaction spread than an additive average, which lets one extreme substitute for the other.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: The conjunctive MIN aggregator already worked well on its first test (5.1% alpha, t=4.10, Sharpe 0.493) despite using the plainest legs, so pairing it with the strongest cheapness-quality composite is the right final test of whether the interaction is conjunctive in nature. This distinguishes the economics of the finding — a joint condition — from the additive rank convenience used throughout.
INTERACTION_TYPE: conditional

---SIGNAL 6---
NAME: Final_CashNetKnowledgeDual_CashProfitability
EXPRESSION: SUMRANK(SUMRANK(RATIO(ADD(COALESCE(oancf, ib), COALESCE(xrd, SUB(at, at))), MUL(prcc_f, csho)), SUMRANK(RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), MA(revt, 3)), RATIO(SUB(COALESCE(TS_SUM(xrd, 5), SUB(at, at)), COALESCE(gdwl, SUB(at, at))), at))), RATIO(oancf, at))
HYPOTHESIS: Quality should be measured in cash as well: firms generating operating cash flow on their asset base are the ones whose hidden intangible capital is economically productive, and cash profitability is harder to manipulate than gross margin for intangible-heavy firms whose cost structure sits below the gross-profit line.
EXPECTED_SIGN: positive
REASONING: Gross profitability was the quality screen that lifted FMB slopes above 6.5, but for R&D-intensive firms most intangible spending is expensed *below* gross profit, so gross margin may overstate quality exactly where the mechanism operates. Swapping in cash profitability while holding everything else at the Signal 1 specification isolates the quality-measurement choice and could improve both slope and Sharpe.
INTERACTION_TYPE: composite
